product.name: Regular Fit Suit Pants
product.description: Regular-fit suit pants in soft, woven fabric with a comfortable, classic silhouette. Extended waistband tab with hook-and-bar fastening and zip fly with concealed button. Side pockets, welt back pockets with button, and legs with creases.
